title: Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control

beats.text: Before you deploy your next physical policy, see how Reflex unlocks 85.7% better precision.
beats.visual_focus: A Unitree G1 robot standing still while a box flies past it.

beats.text: The villain is latency. Waiting to render a full 3D scene before moving is a death sentence.
beats.visual_focus: A split screen showing a slow rendering pipeline versus a fast motor command.

beats.text: Reflex shatters this by splitting the brain, separating visual perception from the whole-body motor controller.
beats.visual_focus: An architectural diagram showing the separation of the policy and the encoder.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: This actually slapped. You didn't waste time with 'Hey guys' or 'In this video,' and you didn't treat me like I'm five. Explaining the latency issue as a 'death sentence' for the arm movement made total sense. I liked that you actually explained the 'shortcut' as a compressed vector instead of just saying 'AI magic.' It felt like a real dev breakdown.
